title: Best of Japan | A Cultural Odyssey Across Osaka & Tokyo
highlights: Discover Tokyo and Osaka, where historic temples, futuristic skylines, and local delicacies come together for a truly unforgettable Japanese adventure.
Glide above the active volcanic Owakudani Valley on the Hakone Ropeway, offering stunning views of Mount Fuji, sulfur vents, and the picturesque Lake Ashinoko.
Visit the Tokyo Imperial Palace, a symbol of Japan's heritage, featuring historic Edo Castle ruins, Nijubashi Bridge, and the scenic East Gardens.
Step into a world of fantasy at Tokyo Disneyland, featuring beloved Disney characters, magical parades, and iconic attractions like “It’s a Small World” and “Space Mountain.”
Walk along Dotonbori, Osaka’s lively entertainment district, known for its glowing neon lights, culinary delights like takoyaki, and the iconic Glico Running Man.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Tokyo | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Tokyo! Upon arrival at Narita International Airport, get transferred to your hotel. Check in and spend the day at your leisure. You can begin your tour by exploring Ginza, Tokyo's renowned upscale shopping district. Next, you can visit the Samurai Theater in Tokyo, which features a wide collection of historical armour. Afterwards, you can explore other sites such as Yoyogi Park, Sumida Park & Omotesando, among other attraction points.

days.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour by Bus
days.desc: Today, head to the pick-up point- LOVE Sculpture & board your transfer for the city tour. Visit Meiji Jingu Shrine, Tokyo Tower, & Tokyo Skytree followed by a stop at Imperial Palace, the historic centre of Japan's royal family. Next, explore Senso-ji Temple, Tokyo’s oldest temple, & head to Odaiba District, a vibrant area known for various shopping & dining options. After the tour, get driven to 1-chōme-7-2 Nishishinjuku, Shinjuku City, from where you can return to the hotel on your own.

items.title: Full Day Tokyo City Tour by Bus - From LOVE Statue with Lunch

days.title: Day Trip To Mount Fuji- 5th Station & Hakone
days.desc: Today, head to the pickup point- Giulio Paolini Sculpture: "Kaleidoscorpio" & from there, get driven to iconic Mt. Fuji's 5th Station. Once there, admire views of Fuji Five Lakes & the stunning surroundings. Next, embark on an exciting Hakone ropeway ride, offering views as you ascend towards Owakudani Valley, a volcanic region with bubbling sulfur springs & active vents. Afterwards, get driven to Odawara Station to board the bullet train to Tokyo. From there, return to the hotel on your own.

items.title: Mount Fuji and Hakone 1 Day Tour From Tokyo - Return via Bullet Train with Lunch
Transfer in Bullet Train (Shinkansen)
items.desc: 1 X Bullet Train (Shinkansen) will be Provided

days.title: Day Trip to Disneyland
days.desc: Prepare for an exciting full-day adventure at Tokyo Disneyland. Begin by getting driven to the park, where you'll explore its seven themed zones, such as World Bazaar, Tomorrowland, Adventureland, and Fantasyland, home to the iconic Cinderella Castle. Enjoy classic attractions like "Space Mountain," "Pirates of the Caribbean," and "It's a Small World," along with vibrant parades and breathtaking fireworks. After an unforgettable day, you'll be driven back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Tokyo Disneyland Tickets - Admission Tickets to Tokyo Disneyland

days.title: Arrival in Osaka | Day at Leisure
days.desc: After checking out of your hotel in Tokyo, head to Tokyo Station on your own and board the Shinkansen bullet train (tickets included) to Osaka. Upon arrival, make your way to the hotel on your own. Check in and spend the day at leisure. You can relax in the scenic Tennoji Park or head to the Umeda Sky Building to capture stunning city views. You can also visit Osaka Castle or the Shitennō-ji Temple, among many other attractions.

items.title: Osaka Museum Of Housing And Living
items.label: Suggestion

days.title: Osaka Walking Tour | Leisure Time
days.desc: Today, head to the Osaka Tourist Information Center to begin your Osaka walking tour. Begin with the Shinsekai district, known for its retro charm and local dining spots. Continue to Hozenji Yokocho, a quaint alley that houses the Hozenji Temple. Next, stroll through the lively Dotonbori District, ending the tour at Ebisu Bridge, offering scenic views of the bustling Dotonbori Canal. Afterward, you can explore Osaka on your own, visiting places like the Osaka Museum of History & Umeda District.

days.title: Day Trip to Kyoto & Nara
days.desc: Today, head to Namba OCAT Building for your Kyoto & Nara tour. Begin with a visit to the iconic Kinkaku-ji Temple in Kyoto, renowned for its picturesque gardens and ponds. Next, travel to Nara to explore Nara Park, where you can interact with friendly deer. Further, visit the historic Todai-ji Temple, home to the colossal Great Buddha statue, a masterpiece of Japanese heritage. After the tour, get driven to the Namba OCAT Building and make your way back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Full-Day Tour to Kyoto & Nara - Osaka Namba Dep/Buffet Lunch

days.title: Day Trip to Universal Studios
days.desc: Today, get driven to the Universal Studios, a world of adventure and entertainment. Explore its vibrant themed zones, including the Minion Park, the prehistoric wonders of Jurassic Park and the Universal Wonderland. Step into The Wizarding World of Harry Potter to experience the magic of Hogwarts & feel the adrenaline on thrilling rides like The "Flying Dinosaur" and "Jurassic Park: The Ride". After a fun filled day, get driven back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: Today, check out of the hotel and get transferred to Kansai International Airport, where your trip comes to an end.
